messages.subject: help with hline.data
parts:
Hi,

I am quite new to ggplot, and am having some problems adding hline to
a plot with facet_grid. the example on: http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_hline.html
only has 4 facets while I need 6...

I uploaded the data file (calc_ratios_sd.txt)

this is the code I am using

# sette limits (max, min) til errorbar
limits <- aes(ymax =Non_auto + SD_nonauto, ymin = Non_auto -
SD_nonauto)

# sette posisjon
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.9)

# lage Redfield linjer med geom_hline
hline.data <- data.frame(z = c(6.6, 6.6, 106, 106, 16, 16), Ratio =
c(0,0,1,1,2,2), Station = c(0,1,0,1,0,1))

nonauto <- ggplot (D, aes(Season, Non_auto)) + geom_bar(position =
"dodge", stat = "identity") + geom_errorbar (limits, position = dodge,
width=0.25) + facet_grid (Ratio ~ Station, scales = "free_y") + labs
(x = "Season", y = "Non-Autotrophic ratios")
nonauto + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = z), hline.data)

and I get the errror:
Error in is.vector(X) : subscript out of bounds

I know I am probably doing something very stupid here, but I cannot
quite figure it out. can someone point me in the right direction?

Helene
